stories.title: 12 doden en 300 gewonden bij Houthi-aanval op luchthaven in Saoedi-Arabië

en.title: 12 dead and 300 wounded in Houthi attack on airport in Saudi Arabia
en.summary: A Houthi rebel attack on an airport in Riyadh resulted in 12 deaths and over 300 injuries when the passenger terminal was struck.

stories.title: Brede verontwaardiging over aanval op luchthaven Riyad: 'Gevaarlijke escalatie'

en.title: Broad outrage over attack on Riyadh airport: 'Dangerous escalation'
en.summary: World leaders condemned a Houthi rebel attack on Riyadh airport that killed 12 and wounded over 300, characterizing it as a dangerous escalation in the regional conflict.

stories.title: Trump wil nieuwe Oekraïense president na dieselakkoord met Poetin

en.title: Trump wants new Ukrainian president after diesel deal with Putin
en.summary: President Trump called for replacing Ukraine's president after reaching an agreement with Russia's Putin regarding diesel supplies.

stories.title: VN-chef Guterres ‘geschokt’ door aanval op luchthaven Riyad

en.title: UN chief Guterres 'shocked' by attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: The UN secretary-general expressed shock regarding the attack on Riyadh airport.

stories.title: Justitie VS onderzoekt tv-zenders die verslaggeving over Trump opschortten

en.title: US Justice Department investigates TV stations that suspended Trump coverage
en.summary: The US Department of Justice is investigating television broadcasters that halted their reporting over Trump.

stories.title: 12 doden en 300 gewonden bij aanval op luchthaven Riyad

en.title: 12 dead and 300 wounded in attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: An attack on Riyadh's international airport in Saudi Arabia resulted in at least twelve deaths and 300 injuries, according to Saudi civil aviation authorities. Houthi rebels claimed responsibility, stating the attack was retaliation for Saudi airstrikes on Yemen.

stories.title: Zeker twaalf doden en driehonderd gewonden na aanval op luchthaven Riyad

en.title: At least twelve dead and three hundred wounded after attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: A severe attack on Riyadh's international airport on Saturday killed at least twelve people and injured 309 others. Houthi rebels are suspected of carrying out the attack, which represents the deadliest incident in the Gulf region since the conflict with Iran began.

stories.title: Trump haalt uit naar Zelensky: 'Tijd voor nieuwe president die deal kan sluiten'

en.title: Trump attacks Zelensky: 'Time for new president who can make a deal'
en.summary: President Trump criticized Ukrainian President Zelensky, stating Ukraine needs different leadership capable of negotiating an end to the war with Russia. Trump has previously opposed Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil facilities.

stories.title: Tot zeker 23.00 uur geen treinen tussen Rotterdam en Delft na brandstichting

en.title: No trains between Rotterdam and Delft until at least 23:00 after arson
en.summary: Train service between Rotterdam and Delft is suspended following arson at a rail bridge in Rotterdam-Delfshaven. Repairs are expected to take until at least Sunday evening, with possible delays extending into Monday morning.

stories.title: Nog het hele weekend geen treinen tussen Rotterdam en Delft na brandstichting bij spoorbrug

en.title: No trains between Rotterdam and Delft throughout the weekend after arson at railway bridge
en.summary: Train service between Rotterdam and Delft is disrupted for the entire weekend due to an arson incident at a railway bridge.

stories.title: Zeker tot zondagavond geen treinen tussen Rotterdam en Delft na brandstichting

en.title: No trains between Rotterdam and Delft at least until Sunday evening after arson
en.summary: Train service on the Rotterdam-Delft route will resume earliest on Sunday evening following an arson incident. ProRail initially expected repairs to be completed Saturday evening but determined the damage resulted from deliberate fire-setting.

stories.title: Geen treinverkeer op spoor tussen Rotterdam en Delft door brandstichting

en.title: No train traffic on track between Rotterdam and Delft due to arson
en.summary: A fire at a railroad bridge halted train service between Rotterdam Centraal and Delft Campus throughout Saturday, with authorities finding no immediate connection to recent rail sabotage incidents.
